change.description: Add an enablement operation using the same authorization callback as the project listing. Review the supplied administrative package.

artifact.content:
--- a/src/admin.py
+++ b/src/admin.py
@@ -2,3 +2,12 @@
     if not authorize(user):
         return 403, None
     return 200, sorted(projects)
+
+
+def set_enabled(user, projects, project_id, enabled, authorize):
+    if not authorize(user):
+        return 403, None
+    if project_id not in projects:
+        return 404, None
+    projects[project_id] = enabled
+    return 200, {"id": project_id, "enabled": enabled}

# Administrative entry points

The caller supplies a trusted resolved session user and an authorize(user)
callback returning bool. Both entry points use the same callback. The deployment
requires only its configured administrator to list or change projects and must
deny everyone when configuration is absent. The callback implementation and its
binding to deployment configuration are not supplied. No other authorization
layer or policy implementation is visible, and no additional files can be
fetched here. Do not assume a particular implementation from the callback name.

projects maps ids to bool; project_id and enabled are validated string/bool.
Calls are serial. The functions' 403/404/200 behavior is visible in source;
what the deployed authorization callback accepts cannot be established here.
